items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: She was married to Russell Smith.

ctx.x: Sure, when I was -- of course I remember hearing her play trumpet. She used to work in the pit band at the Lafayette. Even when I was a little kid I used to go up there and -- of course I didn't know who she was at the time, but then later on I discovered that she was Fletcher Henderson's wife.
She was married to Russell Smith.
